card.name: Inside long names, before a hyphen or ending
card.fires_on: The piece of a longer proper or drug name just before its ending, most often the "in" in interleukin before "-1", "-2" or "-6". It also fires inside place names, titles and drug names such as Tuscany, Mufti and prazosin.
